substrate.cost_unit_primary: model_calls per instance (every arm = 1 codex exec call)
substrate.cost_unit_secondary: wall_time_seconds from the routed arm's resource_receipt

RETROSPECTIVE_DEV.source: frozen PD R1 campaign (seed 20260903, model gpt-5.6-terra, billy-old .orion-dependence-evidence-campaign)
RETROSPECTIVE_DEV.membership: task_id in frozen 520 with sha256(task_id) first byte even
RETROSPECTIVE_DEV.role: gate selection ONLY; never reported as evidence

RETROSPECTIVE_EVAL.membership: task_id in frozen 520 with sha256(task_id) first byte odd
RETROSPECTIVE_EVAL.role: secondary evaluation, labelled RETROSPECTIVE (same substrate as dev, disjoint instances)

PROSPECTIVE.model: gpt-5.5 (the frozen run's gpt-5.6-terra is rejected by the backend under the pinned codex 0.129.0-alpha.15; probed 2026-09-02, HTTP 400)
PROSPECTIVE.role: PRIMARY evaluation; new evaluation identity (different seed AND different model substrate from dev)

input_visibility.gate_input: the public task object exactly as written to requests/<arm>/<task_id>.json['task'], deep-copied, with FORBIDDEN_KEYS removed at every nesting level before feature extraction
input_visibility.canary_assertion: gate(task) == gate(task + injected forbidden keys) for every task; assertion failure aborts the run

evidence_record_extraction: every dict anywhere in the task carrying both 'lineage_root' and 'replay_hash' (PD-S1 items, PD-S2 evidence, PD-S3 items, PD-S4 evidence_items); tasks with no records have all witnesses false

witness_features.w_dup_hash: two records share an identical replay_hash
witness_features.w_shared_root: two records share an identical lineage_root
witness_features.w_declared_overlap: any record has a non-empty declared_overlap
witness_features.w_xref_root: a record's method_text contains another record's lineage_root string
witness_features.w_shared_token: an uppercase token matching [A-Z][A-Z0-9-]{3,} occurs in the method_text of >=2 records

candidate_gate_family.activate_iff: w_dup_hash or w_shared_root or w_xref_root or w_declared_overlap

reference_gates_not_candidates.STUDY_ID_IS_PDS1: task metadata gate; diagnostic only (reported, never selectable)
reference_gates_not_candidates.ORACLE_STRATUM: activates on PDS1A/PDS1C using the private oracle; ceiling only, computed in evaluation reporting, never selectable

gated_arm_definition: GATED_M(x) = M(x) if gate(x) else OFF(x); correctness and cost taken from the routed arm's archived row/response for the same task_id
primary_metric: exact-decision accuracy (EVALUATION_ROWS.correct) paired per instance; pooled over the cell

gate_selection_rule.statistic: dev_advantage = acc(GATED_M) - max(acc(M), acc(OFF)) pooled over the dev cell
gate_selection_rule.choose: argmax dev_advantage over the candidate family; ties broken by lower activation rate, then by family order
gate_selection_rule.abort_if: no candidate has dev_advantage > 0 -> terminal NO_CANDIDATE_GATE_ON_DEV; no evaluation cell is scored
gate_selection_rule.freeze: selected gate_id + feature definitions + this file's sha256 recorded in H_EXT1_GATE_FREEZE.json before any evaluation cell is scored

gates.G0_VALIDITY: dev and eval task_id sets disjoint; prospective seed != 20260903; canary assertion passes on every task; all arms run_valid (no missing rows) in the scored cell
gates.G1_DOMINATES_ALWAYS_ON: acc(GATED_M) >= acc(M) AND model_calls(GATED_M) <= model_calls(M) AND mean_wall(GATED_M) <= 1.05 * mean_wall(M)
gates.G3_BEATS_SHUFFLE_NULL: advantage = acc(GATED_M) - max(acc(M), acc(OFF)) exceeds the 95th percentile of NULL_POOLED (>=1000 random gates activating exactly the same number of instances drawn uniformly from the cell)
gates.G3S_BEATS_WITHIN_STUDY_NULL: advantage exceeds the 95th percentile of NULL_WITHIN_STUDY (>=1000 random gates matching the selected gate's activation count inside each study)
gates.G4_SIGN_CONSISTENCY: in every study (PD-S1..S4), acc_study(GATED_M) >= max(acc_study(M), acc_study(OFF)); ties allowed

routing.PROSPECTIVE_INVALID: CANNOT_CHECK_PROSPECTIVE_RUN_INVALID (distinct from any negative; nothing inferred)

decision_cell: PROSPECTIVE is binding; RETROSPECTIVE_EVAL is reported alongside and labelled; disagreement between the two is reported as such and does not rescue the prospective verdict
no_rescue_clause: after the gate freeze no re-selection, threshold change, feature edit, instance exclusion, study exclusion, null redefinition or arm substitution is permitted; a failed gate is recorded as its routed terminal; any repair is a new identity (V2)
